synthesis:draft.headline: As of 07:00 AEST on 2026-08-06 the latest public POE50 forecast available for TAS1 for the half-hour ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST was 1084.0 MW (evidence ev0538).
summary: The forecast run PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202608060430_20260806040126 (available by the 07:00 AEST as-of) provided a POE50 of 1084.0 MW for the half-hour ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST — evidence ev0538.
An earlier public forecast run in the snapshot had a different POE50 for the same half-hour ending 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST: 1160.0 MW — evidence ev0034.

Other POE50 values in the latest-as-of run include 1377.0 MW for the half-hour ending 2026-08-06 07:30 AEST (evidence ev0505) and 1417.0 MW for the half-hour ending 2026-08-06 19:00 AEST (evidence ev0574).

Provably-public initial actual operational demand values available by the as-of time ended earlier in the returned series; the window maximum provably-public initial actual in the returned series is 1053.0 MW for interval ending 2026-08-05 04:00 AEST — evidence ev0582.

An automated forecast-vs-actual comparison could not be produced as-of the cutoff because aligned provably-public actuals for the forecast target intervals were not available (the compare tool returned 'no aligned forecast/actual pairs').
